## Solution

**Rock salt structure** is an FCC lattice with **4 formula units per unit cell** ($Z = 4$). The anion and cation touch along the unit cell edge, so:

$$a = 2(r_{\mathrm{Ni}^{2+}} + r_{\mathrm{O}^{2-}}) = 2(0.069 + 0.140)\,\text{nm} = 0.418\,\text{nm} = 4.18\times10^{-8}\,\text{cm}$$

The theoretical density is:

$$\rho = \frac{Z \cdot \sum A}{N_A \cdot a^3}$$

where $\sum A = 58.69 + 16.00 = 74.69\ \text{g/mol}$ and $N_A = 6.022\times10^{23}\ \text{mol}^{-1}$.

$$\rho = \frac{4 \times 74.69}{(6.022\times10^{23})(4.18\times10^{-8})^3} \approx 6.79\ \text{g/cm}^3$$

$$\boxed{6.79}$$
